card: tv-recap (follow-ups: 'Menu on the landing spends a model call via /api/memory' + 'screens.tsx and MathsTV/EssayTV import each other')
deviations_from_card: (1) Finding 1, decided from the code: the recap was already model-free. Its tiles and caption come from the history lines and the session (recapRows, parseDetail, recapCaption); nothing the recap draws uses the model. The model call was the memory write that tv-surface B chained onto Menu, as the phone's End session does. The later prompts (items, explain, hint) read that memory, so the write was kept and deduplicated, not dropped. /api/memory now answers {lines:[]} with no engine call in two cases: the evening has no marked item and no hint, or the last finished (done) memory job was asked about this same evening. The key is a sha256 of the learner id, topic, items (n, question, verdict, slip, working) and hints, held as jobs.memory.key on the session (runJob's key option), so the session store stays the only state. A failed write is tried again, and a hint or verdict added since counts as new. Engine calls: two opens of one evening 2 -> 1, a quiet evening 1 -> 0, a repeat open 1 -> 0. keys.ts is untouched: Menu still posts /api/memory (case 4 unchanged). The first open of an evening with work still costs one model call, by design. (2) Cases: follow-up 1 (engine throws, every tile and the caption render) was green before, because the recap never needed the model. It is counted as a case, not a guard. Red before: follow-up 2 (two opens, at most 1 call; it was 2), follow-up 3 (quiet evening, 0 calls; it was 1), follow-up 4 (0 import cycles; there were 2: screens->MathsTV->screens and screens->EssayTV->screens). Guards: new work or a failed write is written again; the recap's rendered markup for Ema's evening and Jakub's quiet one hashes to the golden values recorded at ad6c731 (this is the brief's 'tiles unchanged' guard and finding 2's 'no visible change'); the scan-bites self-test (a seeded in-memory cycle is found, a commented import is not). (3) The leaf is desk/src/tv/marks.tsx. It holds MathsMark, EssayBrand, EssayArrow and Essay Master's CIT/BONE, and imports nothing. MathsTV and EssayTV import them under their old local names (Mark, Brand, Arrow) and no longer export them. screens.tsx and LandingTV.tsx import from the leaf. Linga's mark stays in english/OpenDoor.tsx, which was already a leaf. (4) The cycle scan also covered type-only imports; the result was the same, 2 before and 0 after. A cycle was seeded by hand in the real tree (screens.tsx importing @/maths/MathsTV): follow-up 4 went red with 'tv/screens.tsx -> maths/MathsTV.tsx -> tv/screens.tsx', and the seed was removed. (5) Series 1 commit message says 'Acceptance 2/4 -> 4/4'. The accurate figure is in this file: 5 cases in series 1, 2 of them red before, 2 guards, and 1 green before by nature.
